fields.rt-blog-html:
Should you outsource your franchise development? Outsourcing your franchise development can be a real asset in terms of efficiency and expertise. However, it's essential to choose your partners carefully and keep a close eye on the process to avoid pitfalls. Explore the background, benefits and risks of outsourcing your franchise in this comprehensive guide.

‍

What is franchise outsourcing?

Franchise outsourcing means entrusting certain tasks, or the entire process of developing your franchise, to a specialized external company. This can include a variety of tasks, such as finding franchisees, training, setting up management systems, marketing and operational support. 

In other words, instead of managing the development of your franchise in-house, you delegate these responsibilities to experts who have the experience and resources needed to ensure the efficient and successful expansion of your franchise network.

👉 To find out more: How to effectively develop your fast-food franchise network

‍

What are the challenges of developing a franchise?

In 2023, the number of franchised outlets in France reached 92,132, marking a 9% increase on 2022, according to Franchise Magazine. With such growth, the management and development needs of franchises increase, underlining the importance of outsourcing to manage this expansion effectively. Outsourcing represents an effective strategic solution for keeping pace with this growth, in an economic context where companies are seeking to optimize their resources.

👉 Going further: 37 questions to ask yourself before launching a restaurant franchise

‍

What are the 3 advantages of outsourcing franchise development?

1. Save time and increase efficiency

When you outsource, you save time. Franchise development agencies have the tools, skills and experience to get things done quickly and efficiently. So you can concentrate on what you do best: delivering an exceptional experience to your customers.

2. Internal cost reduction

Hiring people in-house to develop your franchise can be expensive. With outsourcing, you don't have to manage salaries, benefits and training. You pay for a service, and that's it!

3. Specialized expertise

Franchise development agencies know the ropes. They have the expertise to avoid the pitfalls and maximize your chances of success. Their know-how can make the difference between a failed expansion and a resounding success.

‍

What are the risks associated with outsourcing franchise development?

Loss of confidentiality

Outsourcing also means sharing sensitive information about your company. This is why you need to choose partners you can trust, and draw up confidentiality agreements to prevent any leakage of information.

Loss of autonomy

When you outsource, you delegate some of the control. This can be destabilizing, especially if you're used to managing everything yourself. Finding the right balance between delegation and supervision is crucial.

The drain on skills and expertise

By entrusting the development of your franchise to an external company, you run the risk of not developing these skills in-house. In the long term, this can be a hindrance if you ever want to take over the reins.

Dependence on the subcontracting company or service provider

Outsourcing can create a dependency on your service provider. If the latter encounters problems, this can have a direct impact on your development. Diversifying your partners can be a solution to limit this risk.

‍

How do I choose a franchise development agency?

Using a franchise development agency

To choose a good agency, several criteria need to be taken into account:

  • ‍his or herexperience in the sector, particularly in catering if that's your field,
  • its reputation in the market,
  • and feedback from former customers.

An agency that has already worked with similar companies will have a better understanding of your specific needs.

Don't forget to ask about their working methods: how do they recruit franchisees, what strategies do they use to develop a network, and how do they optimize operations?

Ask for concrete examples of past successes and solid references from brands they've worked with.

Finally, evaluate their rates according to the services they offer, and compare them with other agencies to find the one that best matches your development ambitions.

Firms such as Progressium, Axe Réseaux and Franchise Managementspecializing in the foodservice industry in France, can be strong partners in this process.

Using a franchise development consultant or facilitator

Calling on a specialized consultant or franchise network facilitator can also be a good option. He or she will provide you with personalized support and advice tailored to your specific situation. As with the choice of an agency, be sure to ask for references, and to check that their way of working matches your needs.

‍

How much does it cost to outsource franchise development?

The budget for outsourcing your franchise development can vary considerably. It depends on a number of factors: the size of your project, the level of support you require, and the specifics of your business sector. 

According to a study by Franchise Direct, the cost of outsourcing can represent between 5% and 10% of annual franchise revenues. Compare the costs with those of an in-house team to see which is more advantageous for you.

‍

How do you measure the success of franchise development outsourcing?

To measure the success of outsourcing, you need to define clear, measurable objectives from the outset. Analyze your initial needs and evaluate the results achieved. Regular monitoring and adjustments along the way are essential to ensure that everything goes according to plan.
